title: Gate 0007 Human_TURN Execution Authorization
description: Mechanical authorization artifact required at evidence/human_turn_execution_authorization.json before the Gate 0007 controller may reserve the attempt. The controller must verify identity constants, hash bindings, seal binding, and the mandatory 900-second window, and must refuse reservation when current_utc >= expires_at_utc.

authorized_at_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with Z suffix captured at the actual moment of Human_TURN authorization. Must be later than the preexecution seal timestamp.

expires_at_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with Z suffix. Mandatory. Must equal authorized_at_utc plus exactly 900 seconds. The controller must refuse reservation when current_utc >= expires_at_utc, with no grace period, automatic extension, or timestamp regeneration.

preexecution_seal_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sealed preexecution manifest. The controller must recompute the manifest hash and refuse on mismatch.
